atoms.name: div
atoms.rule: a / b divides and rounds toward zero (-7 / 2 = -3); b = 0 gives NaN.
atoms.plain: a / b divides and rounds toward zero (-7 / 2 = -3); b = 0 gives NaN.
atoms.plain_zh: a / b 是向零取整的除法，b = 0 时结果为 NaN。

atoms.name: mod
atoms.rule: a % b is the remainder a - b * (a / b), with the sign of a (-7 % 2 = -1); b = 0 gives NaN.
atoms.plain: a % b is the remainder a - b * (a / b), with the sign of a (-7 % 2 = -1); b = 0 gives NaN.
atoms.plain_zh: a % b 是余数 a - b * (a / b)，符号与 a 相同，b = 0 时结果为 NaN。

atoms.name: neg
atoms.rule: - a is the negation of a.
atoms.plain: - a is the negation of a.
atoms.plain_zh: - a 是 a 的相反数。

atoms.name: reverse
atoms.rule: a @ reverses the decimal digits of |a| and keeps the sign of a (120 @ = 21, -123 @ = -321).
atoms.plain: a @ reverses the decimal digits of |a| and keeps the sign of a (120 @ = 21, -123 @ = -321).
atoms.plain_zh: a @ 把 |a| 的十进制数字倒过来写，再保留 a 的符号。

atoms.name: triangle
atoms.rule: # a is sign(a) * |a| * (|a| + 1) / 2, computed exactly; only its result is checked against the bound (# 4 = 10, # -4 = -10).
atoms.plain: # a is sign(a) * |a| * (|a| + 1) / 2, computed exactly; only its result is checked against the bound (# 4 = 10, # -4 = -10).
atoms.plain_zh: # a 是带符号三角数 sign(a) * |a| * (|a| + 1) / 2。

atoms.name: popcount
atoms.rule: a $ is the number of 1 bits in the binary form of |a| (7 $ = 3).
atoms.plain: a $ is the number of 1 bits in the binary form of |a| (7 $ = 3).
atoms.plain_zh: a $ 是 |a| 的二进制里 1 的个数。

atoms.name: digitsum
atoms.rule: & a is sign(a) times the sum of the decimal digits of |a| (& -123 = -6).
atoms.plain: & a is sign(a) times the sum of the decimal digits of |a| (& -123 = -6).
atoms.plain_zh: & a 是 |a| 的各位数字之和，再乘上 a 的符号。

domain.en: Values are hours 0 to 11; inputs and results are reduced modulo 12.
domain.zh: 取值是 0 到 11 的时刻，输入和结果都对 12 取模。

settings.en: The preset that selects these atoms and defaults.
settings.zh: 选择这些原子和默认设置的预设。

settings.en: Every integer input, literal, and result is reduced modulo this number.
settings.zh: 每个整数输入、常数和结果都对这个数取模。

settings.en: A recursive call reduces its counter modulo a number drawn from this range, so it unfolds fewer times than that number.
settings.zh: 递归计数先对这个范围里抽到的数取模，所以展开次数小于这个数。

settings.en: The range of numbers in generated expressions and branch thresholds.
settings.zh: 生成算式和分支阈值所用的数值范围。

why.en: These atoms are one example. Atoms are chosen by the user: any function with a rule can be registered and the same three composition forms grow operators from it.
why.zh: 这些原子只是一个例子。原子由用户自己选：任何写得出规则的函数都能注册，同样三种组合方式会从它长出新运算符。

operators.name: ♣₁
operators.plain: Multiply a by a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 乘以 a。

operators.name: ▽₂
operators.definition: a ▽₂ b = { 0 @, if a < 8 and b < 1; a + 0, if a < 8 and b >= 7; a + a, else }
operators.plain: If a < 8 and b < 1, reverse the digits of 0; otherwise if a < 8 and b ≥ 7, add 0 to a; otherwise add a to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 8 且 b < 1，把 0 的数字倒过来写；否则若 a < 8 且 b ≥ 7，把 a 加上 0；否则把 a 加上 a。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: □₃
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b % 4| times: apply ▲₃₆ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b % 4| 次：对结果应用 ▲₃₆。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ♣₄
operators.plain: Apply ♤₁₅ to b, then multiply it by a ♤₁₅.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 b 应用 ♤₁₅，再把结果乘以 a ♤₁₅。

operators.name: ■₅
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b % 8| times: apply ♤₁₈ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b % 8| 次：对结果应用 ♤₁₈。

operators.name: ○₆
operators.plain: Take the signed triangle number of a, then multiply it by the digit sum of a.
operators.plain_zh: 先求 a 的带符号三角数，再把结果乘以「a 的数字和」。

operators.name: ♥₇
operators.plain: Take the signed triangle number of a, then take the remainder when dividing it by ○₆ 6.
operators.plain_zh: 先求 a 的带符号三角数，再求结果除以 ○₆ 6 的余数。

operators.name: ♡₈
operators.plain: Apply ○₆ to a, then take the remainder when dividing it by ○₆ b.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ○₆，再求结果除以 ○₆ b 的余数。

operators.name: ♧₉
operators.plain: Take the signed triangle number of a, then multiply it by -7.
operators.plain_zh: 先求 a 的带符号三角数，再把结果乘以 -7。

operators.name: ◆₁₀
operators.plain: Count the one bits of a, then subtract a from it.
operators.plain_zh: 先数 a 的二进制里有几个 1，再从结果中减去 a。

operators.name: ♢₁₁
operators.plain: Divide a by ♥₇ a, rounding toward zero.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 除以 ♥₇ a 并向零取整。

operators.name: ♢₁₂
operators.plain: Add 0 to a, then sum its digits.
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 加上 0，再求结果的各位数字之和。

operators.name: ♧₁₃
operators.plain: Multiply 1 by a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 1 乘以 a。

operators.name: ♣₁₄
operators.plain: Apply ♣₁ to 4, then add ♢₁₂ a to it.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 4 应用 ♣₁，再把结果加上 ♢₁₂ a。

operators.name: ♤₁₅
operators.plain: Subtract 8 from a.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 中减去 8。

operators.name: △₁₆
operators.plain: Divide a by -a, rounding toward zero.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 除以 -a 并向零取整。

operators.name: ▲₁₇
operators.plain: Take the signed triangle number of a, then divide it by the number of one bits in a, rounding toward zero.
operators.plain_zh: 先求 a 的带符号三角数，再把结果除以「a 的二进制中 1 的个数」并向零取整。

operators.name: ♤₁₈
operators.plain: Add ♣₁₄ a to a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 加上 ♣₁₄ a。

operators.name: ★₁₉
operators.plain: Add a to 10, then apply ♣₁₄ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先把 10 加上 a，再对结果应用 ♣₁₄。

operators.name: ♥₂₀
operators.definition: a ♥₂₀ b = { b % b, if a < 0 and b >= 3 and b < 5; b ♧₁₃, if a >= 0 and a < 9 and b >= 3 and b < 5; - b, else }
operators.plain: If a < 0 and b ≥ 3 and b < 5, take the remainder when dividing b by b; otherwise if 0 ≤ a < 9 and b ≥ 3 and b < 5, apply ♧₁₃ to b; otherwise negate b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 0 且 b ≥ 3 且 b < 5，求 b 除以 b 的余数；否则若 0 ≤ a < 9 且 b ≥ 3 且 b < 5，对 b 应用 ♧₁₃；否则把 b 取相反数。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ♤₂₁
operators.definition: a ♤₂₁ b = { a + a, if a >= 11 and b < 0; b - 1, if a >= 11 and b >= 3; a @, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 11 and b < 0, add a to a; otherwise if a ≥ 11 and b ≥ 3, subtract 1 from b; otherwise reverse the digits of a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 11 且 b < 0，把 a 加上 a；否则若 a ≥ 11 且 b ≥ 3，从 b 中减去 1；否则把 a 的数字倒过来写。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ♤₂₂
operators.definition: a ♤₂₂ b = { # a, if a < 6 and b >= 5 and b < 7; (♣₁ a) * a, else }
operators.plain: If a < 6 and b ≥ 5 and b < 7, take the signed triangle number of a; otherwise apply ♣₁ to a, then multiply it by a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 6 且 b ≥ 5 且 b < 7，求 a 的带符号三角数；否则先对 a 应用 ♣₁，再把结果乘以 a。

operators.name: ♧₂₃
operators.definition: a ♧₂₃ = { 9 ▲₁₇, if a >= 3 and a < 11; a / a, else }
operators.plain: If 3 ≤ a < 11, apply ▲₁₇ to 9; otherwise divide a by a, rounding toward zero.
operators.plain_zh: 若 3 ≤ a < 11，对 9 应用 ▲₁₇；否则把 a 除以 a 并向零取整。

operators.name: ♧₂₄
operators.definition: ♧₂₄ a = { (& 4) * (★₁₉ a), if a >= 2 and a < 5; 2 ♡₈ (& a), else }
operators.plain: If 2 ≤ a < 5, sum the digits of 4, then multiply it by ★₁₉ a; otherwise apply ♡₈ to 2 and (the digit sum of a).
operators.plain_zh: 若 2 ≤ a < 5，先求 4 的各位数字之和，再把结果乘以 ★₁₉ a；否则对 2 和「a 的数字和」应用 ♡₈。

operators.name: ○₂₅
operators.definition: a ○₂₅ b = { (a ♧₁₃) ♤₂₁ (- 1), if a >= 9 and a < 11 and b >= 5 and b < 11; a ♤₂₂ a, else }
operators.plain: If 9 ≤ a < 11 and b ≥ 5 and b < 11, apply ♧₁₃ to a, then apply ♤₂₁ to the result and -1; otherwise compute a ♤₂₂ a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 9 ≤ a < 11 且 b ≥ 5 且 b < 11，先对 a 应用 ♧₁₃，再对结果和 -1 应用 ♤₂₁；否则把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♤₂₂。

operators.name: ♣₂₆
operators.definition: a ♣₂₆ b = { (a ♧₁₃) ♡₈ (♧₂₄ a), if a < 1 and b >= 4 and b < 8; (a ▲₁₇) + (◆₁₀ 1), else }
operators.plain: If a < 1 and b ≥ 4 and b < 8, apply ♧₁₃ to a, then apply ♡₈ to the result and (♧₂₄ a); otherwise apply ▲₁₇ to a, then add ◆₁₀ 1 to it.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 1 且 b ≥ 4 且 b < 8，先对 a 应用 ♧₁₃，再对结果和 ♧₂₄ a 应用 ♡₈；否则先对 a 应用 ▲₁₇，再把结果加上 ◆₁₀ 1。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ♢₂₇
operators.definition: a ♢₂₇ b = { ♢₁₂ (△₁₆ 1), if a < 6 and b >= 4 and b < 5; (♥₇ b) ♤₂₁ (◆₁₀ a), else }
operators.plain: If a < 6 and b ≥ 4 and b < 5, apply △₁₆ to 1, then apply ♢₁₂ to the result; otherwise apply ♥₇ to b, then apply ♤₂₁ to the result and (◆₁₀ a).
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 6 且 b ≥ 4 且 b < 5，先对 1 应用 △₁₆，再对结果应用 ♢₁₂；否则先对 b 应用 ♥₇，再对结果和 ◆₁₀ a 应用 ♤₂₁。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ♢₂₈
operators.definition: a ♢₂₈ b = { (△₁₆ a) ♤₂₂ (# a), if a >= 4 and a < 5 and b >= 8; ♧₂₄ (b - a), if a >= 6 and b >= 4 and b < 8; (# a) / (○₆ a), else }
operators.plain: Chooses between 3 cases by testing a and b; the cases combine △₁₆, ○₆, ♤₂₂, ♧₂₄, #, - and /.
operators.plain_zh: 按 a、b 的取值在 3 种情形中选一种；各情形组合使用 △₁₆、○₆、♤₂₂、♧₂₄、#、-、/。

operators.name: ♣₂₉
operators.definition: a ♣₂₉ b = { (○₆ a) ♤₂₂ (a ♧₁₃), if a >= 10 and b >= 2 and b < 8; b, if a >= 7 and a < 10 and b >= 2 and b < 8; (△₁₆ b) ♧₁₃, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 10 and b ≥ 2 and b < 8, apply ○₆ to a, then apply ♤₂₂ to the result and (a ♧₁₃); otherwise if 7 ≤ a < 10 and b ≥ 2 and b < 8, return b; otherwise apply △₁₆ to b, then apply ♧₁₃ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 10 且 b ≥ 2 且 b < 8，先对 a 应用 ○₆，再对结果和 a ♧₁₃ 应用 ♤₂₂；否则若 7 ≤ a < 10 且 b ≥ 2 且 b < 8，结果为 b；否则先对 b 应用 △₁₆，再对结果应用 ♧₁₃。

operators.name: ▼₃₀
operators.definition: a ▼₃₀ b = { a ♤₂₁ 0, if a < 5 and b >= 4 and b < 9; ♧₂₄ b, else }
operators.plain: If a < 5 and b ≥ 4 and b < 9, compute a ♤₂₁ 0; otherwise apply ♧₂₄ to b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 5 且 b ≥ 4 且 b < 9，对 a 和 0 应用 ♤₂₁；否则对 b 应用 ♧₂₄。

operators.name: ◆₃₁
operators.plain: Apply ★₁₉ to b, then apply ♢₂₈ to the result and (-a).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 b 应用 ★₁₉，再对结果和 -a 应用 ♢₂₈。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ○₃₂
operators.plain: Apply ♤₂₂ to a and a, then apply ◆₁₀ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♤₂₂，再对结果应用 ◆₁₀。

operators.name: ▼₃₃
operators.definition: a ▼₃₃ = { (♢₁₂ a) ♡₈ (♧₂₄ 4), if a >= 11; 2 ♤₂₁ 5, if a >= 10 and a < 11; (a ▲₁₇) - (♣₁ a), else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 11, apply ♢₁₂ to a, then apply ♡₈ to the result and (♧₂₄ 4); otherwise if 10 ≤ a < 11, compute 2 ♤₂₁ 5; otherwise apply ▲₁₇ to a, then subtract ♣₁ a from it.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 11，先对 a 应用 ♢₁₂，再对结果和 ♧₂₄ 4 应用 ♡₈；否则若 10 ≤ a < 11，对 2 和 5 应用 ♤₂₁；否则先对 a 应用 ▲₁₇，再从结果中减去 ♣₁ a。

operators.name: ▽₃₄
operators.definition: a ▽₃₄ b = { a ○₂₅ (♢₁₂ a), if a >= 9 and b < 8; b ♥₂₀ (★₁₉ b), if a >= 9 and b >= 8 and b < 11; b ▼₃₀ (a ♧₉), else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 9 and b < 8, apply ○₂₅ to a and (♢₁₂ a); otherwise if a ≥ 9 and b ≥ 8 and b < 11, apply ♥₂₀ to b and (★₁₉ b); otherwise apply ▼₃₀ to b and (a ♧₉).
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 9 且 b < 8，对 a 和 ♢₁₂ a 应用 ○₂₅；否则若 a ≥ 9 且 b ≥ 8 且 b < 11，对 b 和 ★₁₉ b 应用 ♥₂₀；否则对 b 和 a ♧₉ 应用 ▼₃₀。

operators.name: ♡₃₅
operators.plain: Apply ♤₁₅ to a, then apply ◆₃₁ to the result and b.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ♤₁₅，再对结果和 b 应用 ◆₃₁。

operators.name: ▲₃₆
operators.plain: Apply ▼₃₃ to a, then apply ▽₂ to the result and a.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ▼₃₃，再对结果和 a 应用 ▽₂。

operators.name: ▼₃₇
operators.plain: Apply ○₃₂ to a, then apply ♣₂₆ to the result and (3 ▲₁₇).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ○₃₂，再对结果和 3 ▲₁₇ 应用 ♣₂₆。

operators.name: △₃₈
operators.definition: a △₃₈ b = { (a / 4) ▼₃₇, if a < 7 and b < 0; (b ▽₃₄ b) ▼₃₃, else }
operators.plain: If a < 7 and b < 0, divide a by 4, rounding toward zero, then apply ▼₃₇ to the result; otherwise apply ▽₃₄ to b and b, then apply ▼₃₃ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 7 且 b < 0，先把 a 除以 4 并向零取整，再对结果应用 ▼₃₇；否则先把 b 同时作为两个输入应用 ▽₃₄，再对结果应用 ▼₃₃。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ○₃₉
operators.plain: Apply ♥₇ to a, then apply ▽₃₄ to the result and (the number of one bits in 0).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ♥₇，再对结果和「0 的二进制中 1 的个数」应用 ▽₃₄。

operators.name: ★₄₀
operators.plain: Compute a ▽₃₄ a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ▽₃₄。

operators.name: ●₄₁
operators.definition: ●₄₁ a = { (○₆ a) + (a ▲₃₆), if a >= 3 and a < 6; (a ▼₃₃) ♡₃₅ (a ▼₃₃), if a >= 6 and a < 10; (8 * a) ★₄₀, else }
operators.plain: If 3 ≤ a < 6, apply ○₆ to a, then add a ▲₃₆ to it; otherwise if 6 ≤ a < 10, apply ▼₃₃ to a, then apply ♡₃₅ to the result and (itself); otherwise multiply 8 by a, then apply ★₄₀ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 若 3 ≤ a < 6，先对 a 应用 ○₆，再把结果加上 a ▲₃₆；否则若 6 ≤ a < 10，先对 a 应用 ▼₃₃，再把结果同时作为两个输入应用 ♡₃₅；否则先把 8 乘以 a，再对结果应用 ★₄₀。

operators.name: □₄₂
operators.plain: Apply ▼₃₃ to a, then apply ●₄₁ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ▼₃₃，再对结果应用 ●₄₁。

operators.name: ♢₄₃
operators.plain: Recurse on a, counting with a % 7: when a % 7 = 0 the result is 8; otherwise let r be the result for (a % 7) - 1 (or (a % 7) + 1 when a % 7 < 0), then add a to r.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 递归，用 a % 7 计数：a % 7 = 0 时结果为 8；否则先求 (a % 7) - 1（a % 7 < 0 时用 (a % 7) + 1）的结果 r，再把 r 加上 a。

operators.name: □₄₄
operators.plain: Recurse on b, counting with b % 6: when b % 6 = 0 the result is 9; otherwise let r be the result for (b % 6) - 1 (or (b % 6) + 1 when b % 6 < 0), then replace r by b ▼₃₀ r.
operators.plain_zh: 对 b 递归，用 b % 6 计数：b % 6 = 0 时结果为 9；否则先求 (b % 6) - 1（b % 6 < 0 时用 (b % 6) + 1）的结果 r，再把 r 换成 b ▼₃₀ r。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ♧₄₅
operators.plain: Recurse on a, counting with a % 9: when a % 9 = 0 the result is 9; otherwise let r be the result for (a % 9) - 1 (or (a % 9) + 1 when a % 9 < 0), then apply ♣₄ to r and a.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 递归，用 a % 9 计数：a % 9 = 0 时结果为 9；否则先求 (a % 9) - 1（a % 9 < 0 时用 (a % 9) + 1）的结果 r，再对 r 和 a 应用 ♣₄。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ♤₄₆
operators.plain: Start with b. Repeat |a % 8| times: negate the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 b 开始，重复 |a % 8| 次：把结果取相反数。

operators.name: ●₄₇
operators.plain: Recurse on a, counting with a % 5: when a % 5 = 0 the result is 3; otherwise let r be the result for (a % 5) - 1 (or (a % 5) + 1 when a % 5 < 0), then replace r by a ♣₄ r.
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 递归，用 a % 5 计数：a % 5 = 0 时结果为 3；否则先求 (a % 5) - 1（a % 5 < 0 时用 (a % 5) + 1）的结果 r，再把 r 换成 a ♣₄ r。

operators.name: ♡₄₈
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b % 3| times: apply ♢₁₁ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b % 3| 次：对结果应用 ♢₁₁。

operators.name: ♡₄₉
operators.plain: Start with b. Repeat |a % 8| times: apply ♤₂₂ to the current value and the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 b 开始，重复 |a % 8| 次：把结果同时作为两个输入应用 ♤₂₂。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ■₅₀
operators.plain: Start with b. Repeat |a % 4| times: apply ▼₃₃ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 b 开始，重复 |a % 4| 次：对结果应用 ▼₃₃。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ♠₅₁
operators.plain: Apply ○₃₂ to a, then apply ■₅ to the result and (a ▼₃₇).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ○₃₂，再对结果和 a ▼₃₇ 应用 ■₅。

operators.name: ♦₅₂
operators.plain: Apply ○₃₂ to b, then apply ■₅ to the result and (○₆ a).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 b 应用 ○₃₂，再对结果和 ○₆ a 应用 ■₅。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ♤₅₃
operators.plain: Apply ♡₄₈ to a and a, then sum its digits.
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♡₄₈，再求结果的各位数字之和。

operators.name: ▽₅₄
operators.plain: Compute a ♡₄₉ a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♡₄₉。

operators.name: ♢₅₅
operators.plain: Compute a □₃ a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 □₃。

operators.name: ◇₅₆
operators.plain: Apply ♡₄₉ to a and (a ♤₁₈).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 a ♤₁₈ 应用 ♡₄₉。

operators.name: ♦₅₇
operators.plain: Compute a ■₅₀ a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ■₅₀。

operators.name: ♧₅₈
operators.plain: Apply ◇₅₆ to a, then apply ♧₄₅ to the result and (◆₁₀ a).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ◇₅₆，再对结果和 ◆₁₀ a 应用 ♧₄₅。

operators.name: ◆₅₉
operators.plain: Apply ♦₅₂ to a and (b ◇₅₆).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 b ◇₅₆ 应用 ♦₅₂。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ♢₆₀
operators.plain: Apply ●₄₇ to b, then apply ■₅₀ to the result and (the signed triangle number of a).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 b 应用 ●₄₇，再对结果和「a 的带符号三角数」应用 ■₅₀。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: △₆₁
operators.plain: Compute a ♤₄₆ a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♤₄₆。

operators.name: ○₆₂
operators.plain: Apply ♧₄₅ to a and a, then apply ♣₁ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♧₄₅，再对结果应用 ♣₁。

operators.name: △₆₃
operators.plain: Apply □₃ to a and (a ▽₅₄).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 a ▽₅₄ 应用 □₃。

operators.name: ●₆₄
operators.plain: Apply ♦₅₂ to a and a, then apply ▼₃₇ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♦₅₂，再对结果应用 ▼₃₇。

operators.name: ♤₆₅
operators.plain: Apply ♠₅₁ to a, then apply ♢₆₀ to the result and (●₄₁ b).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ♠₅₁，再对结果和 ●₄₁ b 应用 ♢₆₀。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: □₆₆
operators.definition: a □₆₆ b = { (♢₅₅ b) ♡₄₈ (○₃₂ b), if a >= 0 and b < 0; (a ♤₁₅) ♡₈ (●₆₄ b), else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 0 and b < 0, apply ♢₅₅ to b, then apply ♡₄₈ to the result and (○₃₂ b); otherwise apply ♤₁₅ to a, then apply ♡₈ to the result and (●₆₄ b).
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 0 且 b < 0，先对 b 应用 ♢₅₅，再对结果和 ○₃₂ b 应用 ♡₄₈；否则先对 a 应用 ♤₁₅，再对结果和 ●₆₄ b 应用 ♡₈。

operators.name: □₆₇
operators.definition: □₆₇ a = { a ▽₂ a, if a >= 1 and a < 3; ●₆₄ a, else }
operators.plain: If 1 ≤ a < 3, compute a ▽₂ a; otherwise apply ●₆₄ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 1 ≤ a < 3，把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ▽₂；否则对 a 应用 ●₆₄。

operators.name: ▼₆₈
operators.definition: a ▼₆₈ b = { (□₆₇ a) ○₂₅ (♧₂₄ b), if a >= 11 and b >= 11; (- a) □₄₄ (♢₅₅ b), else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 11 and b ≥ 11, apply □₆₇ to a, then apply ○₂₅ to the result and (♧₂₄ b); otherwise negate a, then apply □₄₄ to the result and (♢₅₅ b).
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 11 且 b ≥ 11，先对 a 应用 □₆₇，再对结果和 ♧₂₄ b 应用 ○₂₅；否则先把 a 取相反数，再对结果和 ♢₅₅ b 应用 □₄₄。

operators.name: ♦₆₉
operators.definition: ♦₆₉ a = { a, if a < 10; (○₆₂ a) ♤₄₆ (♢₅₅ 11), else }
operators.plain: If a < 10, return a; otherwise apply ○₆₂ to a, then apply ♤₄₆ to the result and (♢₅₅ 11).
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 10，结果为 a；否则先对 a 应用 ○₆₂，再对结果和 ♢₅₅ 11 应用 ♤₄₆。

operators.name: ♣₇₀
operators.definition: a ♣₇₀ b = { a ♧₉, if a >= 6 and b >= 2 and b < 8; 0 ▼₆₈ b, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 6 and b ≥ 2 and b < 8, apply ♧₉ to a; otherwise compute 0 ▼₆₈ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 6 且 b ≥ 2 且 b < 8，对 a 应用 ♧₉；否则对 0 和 b 应用 ▼₆₈。

operators.name: ◇₇₁
operators.definition: a ◇₇₁ = { ♢₅₅ a, if a >= 4 and a < 6; & a, if a >= 2 and a < 4; a, else }
operators.plain: If 4 ≤ a < 6, apply ♢₅₅ to a; otherwise if 2 ≤ a < 4, sum the digits of a; otherwise return a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 4 ≤ a < 6，对 a 应用 ♢₅₅；否则若 2 ≤ a < 4，求 a 的各位数字之和；否则结果为 a。

operators.name: ▼₇₂
operators.definition: ▼₇₂ a = { (2 ♠₅₁) % a, if a >= 0 and a < 2; a ♡₄₈ (a ★₄₀), if a >= 8; ♢₁₂ (a ♣₂₉ a), else }
operators.plain: If 0 ≤ a < 2, apply ♠₅₁ to 2, then take the remainder when dividing it by a; otherwise if a ≥ 8, apply ♡₄₈ to a and (a ★₄₀); otherwise apply ♣₂₉ to a and a, then apply ♢₁₂ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 若 0 ≤ a < 2，先对 2 应用 ♠₅₁，再求结果除以 a 的余数；否则若 a ≥ 8，对 a 和 a ★₄₀ 应用 ♡₄₈；否则先把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♣₂₉，再对结果应用 ♢₁₂。

operators.name: ▽₇₃
operators.definition: a ▽₇₃ b = { 1 □₃ b, if a >= 10 and b < 2; b ♢₄₃ b, if a >= 6 and a < 10 and b < 2; a ◆₃₁ b, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 10 and b < 2, compute 1 □₃ b; otherwise if 6 ≤ a < 10 and b < 2, compute b ♢₄₃ b; otherwise compute a ◆₃₁ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 10 且 b < 2，对 1 和 b 应用 □₃；否则若 6 ≤ a < 10 且 b < 2，把 b 同时作为两个输入应用 ♢₄₃；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ◆₃₁。

operators.name: ○₇₄
operators.definition: a ○₇₄ b = { a % b, if a >= 0 and b >= 11; a ♢₆₀ b, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 0 and b ≥ 11, take the remainder when dividing a by b; otherwise compute a ♢₆₀ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 0 且 b ≥ 11，求 a 除以 b 的余数；否则对 a 和 b 应用 ♢₆₀。

operators.name: ♢₇₅
operators.definition: a ♢₇₅ = { a ◆₅₉ a, if a < 6; □₆₇ a, if a >= 6 and a < 7; a ♢₂₇ 1, else }
operators.plain: If a < 6, compute a ◆₅₉ a; otherwise if 6 ≤ a < 7, apply □₆₇ to a; otherwise compute a ♢₂₇ 1.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 6，把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ◆₅₉；否则若 6 ≤ a < 7，对 a 应用 □₆₇；否则对 a 和 1 应用 ♢₂₇。

operators.name: ☆₇₆
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b % 4| times: apply ♦₆₉ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b % 4| 次：对结果应用 ♦₆₉。

operators.name: ▽₇₇
operators.plain: Recurse on b, counting with b % 5: when b % 5 = 0 the result is a; otherwise let r be the result for (b % 5) - 1 (or (b % 5) + 1 when b % 5 < 0), then replace r by b ♢₆₀ r.
operators.plain_zh: 对 b 递归，用 b % 5 计数：b % 5 = 0 时结果为 a；否则先求 (b % 5) - 1（b % 5 < 0 时用 (b % 5) + 1）的结果 r，再把 r 换成 b ♢₆₀ r。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ◆₇₈
operators.plain: Start with 9. Repeat |a % 6| times: apply ▼₇₂ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 9 开始，重复 |a % 6| 次：对结果应用 ▼₇₂。

operators.name: □₇₉
operators.plain: Start with a. Repeat |b % 6| times: apply △₆₃ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 a 开始，重复 |b % 6| 次：对结果应用 △₆₃。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ♡₈₀
operators.plain: Start with b. Repeat |a % 3| times: apply ♢₅₅ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 b 开始，重复 |a % 3| 次：对结果应用 ♢₅₅。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: ♧₈₁
operators.plain: Start with b. Repeat |a % 8| times: apply ♦₅₇ to the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 b 开始，重复 |a % 8| 次：对结果应用 ♦₅₇。

operators.name: ■₈₂
operators.plain: Start with 11. Repeat |b % 9| times: replace the current value by a ○₇₄ the current value.
operators.plain_zh: 从 11 开始，重复 |b % 9| 次：把结果换成 a ○₇₄ 结果。

operators.name: ◇₈₃
operators.plain: Negate a, then apply ♧₈₁ to the result and (♣₁₄ b).
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 取相反数，再对结果和 ♣₁₄ b 应用 ♧₈₁。

operators.name: □₈₄
operators.plain: Apply ♧₂₄ to a, then apply ◇₈₃ to the result and (a ♢₁₁).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ♧₂₄，再对结果和 a ♢₁₁ 应用 ◇₈₃。

operators.name: ◆₈₅
operators.plain: Compute a ♡₈₀ a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♡₈₀。

operators.name: ♧₈₆
operators.plain: Apply ◇₈₃ to b and (a ♤₁₅).
operators.plain_zh: 对 b 和 a ♤₁₅ 应用 ◇₈₃。

operators.name: ♣₈₇
operators.plain: Compute a ♧₈₆ a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♧₈₆。

operators.name: ◆₈₈
operators.plain: Apply ◆₅₉ to a and (◆₈₅ b).
operators.plain_zh: 对 a 和 ◆₈₅ b 应用 ◆₅₉。

operators.name: ▼₈₉
operators.plain: Apply ♢₄₃ to a and a, then apply ♣₈₇ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♢₄₃，再对结果应用 ♣₈₇。

operators.name: ♢₉₀
operators.plain: Apply □₆₇ to a, then apply □₇₉ to the result and (◆₈₅ 4).
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 □₆₇，再对结果和 ◆₈₅ 4 应用 □₇₉。

operators.name: ♣₉₁
operators.plain: Apply ◆₈₈ to a and a, then apply ★₁₉ to the result.
operators.plain_zh: 先把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ◆₈₈，再对结果应用 ★₁₉。

operators.name: ○₉₂
operators.plain: Compute a ■₈₂ a.
operators.plain_zh: 把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ■₈₂。

operators.name: ◇₉₃
operators.plain: Apply ◇₅₆ to a, then apply ♧₈₆ to the result and b.
operators.plain_zh: 先对 a 应用 ◇₅₆，再对结果和 b 应用 ♧₈₆。

operators.name: ●₉₄
operators.definition: a ●₉₄ b = { b ♢₉₀, if a >= 2 and b >= 2 and b < 8; a ■₅₀ a, else }
operators.plain: If a ≥ 2 and b ≥ 2 and b < 8, apply ♢₉₀ to b; otherwise compute a ■₅₀ a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a ≥ 2 且 b ≥ 2 且 b < 8，对 b 应用 ♢₉₀；否则把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ■₅₀。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ☆₉₅
operators.definition: ☆₉₅ a = { ♢₅₅ (a ◇₈₃ a), if a < 2; (□₆₇ a) ◆₅₉ (○₆₂ a), if a >= 5; a, else }
operators.plain: If a < 2, apply ◇₈₃ to a and a, then apply ♢₅₅ to the result; otherwise if a ≥ 5, apply □₆₇ to a, then apply ◆₅₉ to the result and (○₆₂ a); otherwise return a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 2，先把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ◇₈₃，再对结果应用 ♢₅₅；否则若 a ≥ 5，先对 a 应用 □₆₇，再对结果和 ○₆₂ a 应用 ◆₅₉；否则结果为 a。

operators.name: ♥₉₆
operators.definition: a ♥₉₆ b = { a □₃ a, if a >= 3 and a < 6 and b >= 6; ◆₈₅ a, else }
operators.plain: If 3 ≤ a < 6 and b ≥ 6, compute a □₃ a; otherwise apply ◆₈₅ to a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 3 ≤ a < 6 且 b ≥ 6，把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 □₃；否则对 a 应用 ◆₈₅。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order

operators.name: □₉₇
operators.definition: a □₉₇ b = { a ♦₅₂ a, if a < 7 and b >= 4 and b < 10; ▼₈₉ 4, if a >= 7 and b >= 4 and b < 10; 4 ▼₆₈ b, else }
operators.plain: If a < 7 and b ≥ 4 and b < 10, compute a ♦₅₂ a; otherwise if a ≥ 7 and b ≥ 4 and b < 10, apply ▼₈₉ to 4; otherwise compute 4 ▼₆₈ b.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 7 且 b ≥ 4 且 b < 10，把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ♦₅₂；否则若 a ≥ 7 且 b ≥ 4 且 b < 10，对 4 应用 ▼₈₉；否则对 4 和 b 应用 ▼₆₈。

operators.name: □₉₈
operators.definition: a □₉₈ b = { a ■₅ (b ▼₃₇), if a < 11 and b >= 3 and b < 6; b □₇₉ (0 ◆₇₈), if a < 11 and b < 3; a, else }
operators.plain: If a < 11 and b ≥ 3 and b < 6, apply ■₅ to a and (b ▼₃₇); otherwise if a < 11 and b < 3, apply □₇₉ to b and (0 ◆₇₈); otherwise return a.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 11 且 b ≥ 3 且 b < 6，对 a 和 b ▼₃₇ 应用 ■₅；否则若 a < 11 且 b < 3，对 b 和 0 ◆₇₈ 应用 □₇₉；否则结果为 a。

interest.nearest_transform: behavioural duplicate up to argument order and negation

operators.name: ▲₉₉
operators.definition: ▲₉₉ a = { a, if a < 4; a ◆₃₁ a, if a >= 10; 6 ▽₇₇ 5, else }
operators.plain: If a < 4, return a; otherwise if a ≥ 10, compute a ◆₃₁ a; otherwise compute 6 ▽₇₇ 5.
operators.plain_zh: 若 a < 4，结果为 a；否则若 a ≥ 10，把 a 同时作为两个输入应用 ◆₃₁；否则对 6 和 5 应用 ▽₇₇。

operators.name: ♡₁₀₀
operators.definition: a ♡₁₀₀ b = { (●₄₇ b) ♢₉₀, if a >= 6 and a < 7 and b >= 6; ☆₉₅ (b ♧₈₆ a), if a >= 7 and b < 1; (♢₁₂ a) ◆₈₈ (●₄₇ b), else }
operators.plain: If 6 ≤ a < 7 and b ≥ 6, apply ●₄₇ to b, then apply ♢₉₀ to the result; otherwise if a ≥ 7 and b < 1, apply ♧₈₆ to b and a, then apply ☆₉₅ to the result; otherwise apply ♢₁₂ to a, then apply ◆₈₈ to the result and (●₄₇ b).
operators.plain_zh: 若 6 ≤ a < 7 且 b ≥ 6，先对 b 应用 ●₄₇，再对结果应用 ♢₉₀；否则若 a ≥ 7 且 b < 1，先对 b 和 a 应用 ♧₈₆，再对结果应用 ☆₉₅；否则先对 a 应用 ♢₁₂，再对结果和 ●₄₇ b 应用 ◆₈₈。
